summary.value: Action + 10 MP: offer a blessing to your allies — never yourself — each freely refusing or accepting.

system.description: Action + 10 MP: offer a blessing to your allies — never yourself — each freely refusing or accepting. Each accepter gains +(SL × 3) HP/MP recovery and −(SL) damage taken until scene's end, and owes a gift you name, due before their next rest — or the blessing turns curse: −(SL × 3) recovery and +(SL) damage taken until that rest.
